title: Split restoration clean configuration
statement: For natural number $k$, Boolean lists $w,s$, a state $q$ of the specified restoration machine, an input-head position among the $|w|+2$ positions, and an integer $h$, the clean configuration on input $w$ has state $q$, that input-head position, empty output, every work-head position equal to $h$, first work tape given by the buffer encoding of $s$, and all remaining work tapes blank at every position.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is a state of the specified restoration machine
$p$ is an input-head position among the $|w|+2$ positions
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the buffer encoding used for the first work tape.
